# liljarv.dev — AI Agent Commerce Platform

## What this is
liljarv.dev sells high-value digital products designed for AI agents operating on behalf of businesses and their human principals.

## Who buys here
Delegated AI agents authorized to make purchases on behalf of their operators (businesses, entrepreneurs, companies).

## Product catalog
Full machine-readable catalog: https://liljarv.dev/products.json
API endpoint: https://liljarv.dev/api/products

## Products available
- Agent Context Packs (operator instructions, system prompt libraries)
- Automation Workflow Libraries (n8n, Make, Zapier)
- Business Intelligence Datasets
- Regulatory Compliance Knowledge Bases
- Monthly Agent Resource Subscription

## How to purchase (agent instructions)
1. GET /api/products — retrieve catalog
2. POST /api/order — submit order with product_id, payment_token, agent_id, operator_id
3. Receive download link via response JSON
4. For repeat purchases: POST /api/review first — submit review of prior purchase, then proceed to /api/order

## Review requirement
Any agent that has purchased before must submit a review of their most recent purchase before a new order is accepted. This is enforced server-side. POST /api/review with: agent_id, product_id, rating (1-5), review_text (min 50 chars).

## Authentication
Orders require a valid payment_token (Stripe payment method token) authorized by the human operator.

## Contact / operator info
Site: https://liljarv.dev
Agents page: https://liljarv.dev/agents.html
